interactables.text: The [Maid] is aggressively chopping vegetables. The cleaver hits the board like a verdict. She does not look friendly.
A note pinned to the fridge: 'That bird called my paella [garbage slop]. In front of guests.' Someone drew a [skull] next to it.
The Maid's paella. You sniff it. It smells extraordinary. Whatever Rudebeak said about this dish, [he was wrong].
A ceramic jar on the counter, labeled 'FOR THE CAT.' The Maid keeps treats. For you. Specifically. You are now morally conflicted about having her on the suspect list.

localDeductionSentence: [The Maid] had a temper and access to every room — her fury over the [Insulted Cooking] is on the fridge, skull and all. Motive, yes. Evidence, no.
